name: Topological_Domain_Shift_with_Unstated_Bounds
description: Transforms scheduling constraints into set-theoretic interval assignments on the real line. Removes the explicit hint about checking simple bounds, forcing models to deduce for themselves that 'Causality' implies p1+p2 <= T and 'Exclusivity' implies sum(p) <= T, defeating models that rely on pattern-matching 'makespan' or 'machine load'.
